title: ehhh
text:
ehhh. as soon as i opened the box they looked disappointing. wrapped in what looked like old, yellowed cellophane. the smell of the plastic they’re made of was overwhelming when i opened the box.. that can’t be good??

they’re cheap and clunky. i replaced these with Ball brand lids from walmart the next day. don’t waste your time with these.
